title: Archive through May 12, 2004 - Anonymous (Tuesday, April 13, 2004 - 11:01 am)
content: I had four brain operations; they were trying to find a tumor. This was before the CAT Scans, etc., were available in the UK. They used probes etc. Finally they found it and removed it. I lost all sensations: could not talk, walk, do anything for a long time. I spent about 10 days in the intense care section, during which I had stigmata (bleeding palms, line of thorn marks across forehead, etc.). I was then moved to main neuro ward. After about a week on this ward, I had an arrest. I was in a strange sort of funnel. Looking down it narrowed to a point, where there was bright lights, etc. Looking up it went wider and wider to a clear sky, slightly cloudy. I was just standing there, in mid-air, sort of hovering, about in the middle. When I looked up again, there was a large rectangular shape falling towards me. Even now, I always think of it as a huge block of green fairy soap, slowly turning as it fell, tumbling over and over. I suddenly realized by the time it got to me, it would be filling the tunnel, and I'd only be able to go downwards towards the light. I knew somehow that the light was OK, but also that there was more adventure if I went the other way (upwards). I felt myself slowly rising, keeping to the side. And as the huge block passed almost touching me... (Don’t recall anything else.) Notes; I have heard voices sometimes. Following my recovery in 1974, I went to this very hospital to work, and stayed 10 years. Finally I got a great promotion and this I accepted. And as I left the office, this voice said, "This is not for you." Instinctively I swore at the voice, and told the person where to go in no uncertain terms, for hadn’t I worked hard for this promotion. Within a few weeks, I collapsed. A 2nd tumor diagnosed. I was pushed into early retirement, being told that I probably had only around 2 years to live (1984). So, why am I here now in 2004? I often feel I am being punished for swearing at God or whoever. The last time I attempted to get signed off as "well" and get a job, I had a mysterious sudden heart attack (1998), which put paid to that! And shortly after the voice said, "You will wait", so I wait (with great frustration).

environment.environment_other_detail: Clear sky, slightly cloudy; bright lights at the narrowed end of the funnel; large rectangular shape described as a huge block of green fairy soap.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Chose to go upwards because there was 'more adventure' that way; also to avoid being forced downwards toward the light as the falling block would fill the tunnel.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred after multiple brain operations for a tumor; later mentions an 'arrest' about a week after transfer to main neuro ward.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A large rectangular object ('huge block of green fairy soap') falling through the funnel/tunnel, influencing the direction choice.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience focused on being in a funnel/tunnel with light below and open sky above, plus a falling block that forced a directional decision; no OBE, beings, or life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported stigmata during ICU stay (bleeding palms, thorn marks across forehead). Described a large rectangular falling object in the funnel like a tumbling block of green fairy soap. Post-recovery reports hearing a voice giving warnings ('This is not for you', 'You will wait').
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "This is not for you."; "You will wait"
